title: Winter conditions
intro: Weather and alerts from Environment and Climate Change Canada for the pilot area, and the status of our risk layer.

freezeThaw.title: Freeze–thaw in last 24 h
freezeThaw.desc: Derived from observations. Freeze–thaw cycles often make sidewalks slippery, but this does not tell us any specific sidewalk's condition.

alerts.title: Weather alerts
alerts.none: No active alerts in the data received.
alerts.unaltered: Alerts are reproduced exactly as issued by Environment and Climate Change Canada, in the language they were published in.

history.title: 311 winter-report history
history.unavailable: Not available yet. The API (contract v1) has no endpoint for aggregated 311 history, so we show nothing rather than an invented chart. A change request has been filed.

model.title: Risk model status
model.targetNote: This is a proxy for reporting activity, not the physical presence of ice.
